achievements.description: Win a game with the Necroa Virus without making a single zombie
achievements.summary: Win with the Necroa Virus without creating any zombies.

guide.context: The run lasts roughly 4000-4500 in-game days and needs careful save management.

steps.text: Start as the Necroa Virus on Normal difficulty in India with the ATP Boost, Creationist, Aerocyte and Extremophile genes.
Evolve Saliva 1 and Zoonotic Shift, then Bat 1; devolve Bat 1 when the rabid-bat news appears.
Take Heat Resistance 1, Cold Resistance 1 and 2, and Drug Resistance 1, then devolve any mutated symptoms.
Wait until every human is infected while keeping at least 62 DNA points.
Evolve Insomnia, Fever, Photophobia, Coma, Acute Encephalitis and Hyper Salivation at once, never Cytopathic Reanimation.
Use Genetic Hardening and Genetic Reshuffle if the cure gets close while waiting for the rabies-link pop-up.

Leave the USA on the day the count reaches 123 and wait for the 'Sesame Street Killer' news to confirm the unlock.
